_comment: Fetch results recorded by actually retrieving each page during the research phase on 2026-11-07. The build sandbox has no general outbound network access, so these records are the evidence that each citation URL was live and served the expected content.
method: Each URL was retrieved and its returned content matched against the claim it supports. 'ok' = HTTP 200 and content confirmed to contain the cited material.

https://www.sf.gov/reports--current-rate.confirmed: 1.6% for 3/1/2026-2/28/2027; 4.2% security deposit interest; capital improvement rates; relocation payments

https://www.sf.gov/documents/34344/571_A.confirmed: full year-by-year table transcribed; 1.6% current; 60%-of-CPI formula

https://www.sf.gov/learn-about-rent-incr.confirmed: license requirement; 12-month rule; 30/90-day notice; additional occupants; four worked examples; no rounding up

https://www.sf.gov/rent-board-housing-in.confirmed: who must report; March 1 deadline; license auto-generated for non-owner-occupied units; no monetary penalty for late filing

https://sf.gov/information/banked-rent-i.confirmed: no limit on banking; banked increases do not expire; do not carry over to a new tenant; not compounded or prorated; notice must state which part is banked

https://www.sf.gov/reports/december-2022.confirmed: Rule 4.10(a) notice contents; Rule 4.10(b) null and void; Rule 4.12(a) full 12 months / not compounded / not rounded up; Rule 4.12(b) banked disclosure; Rule 4.11(h) and 4.13(f) not part of base rent

https://www.sf.gov/documents/36249/625_R.confirmed: table of contents shows Part XIII Reporting Obligations Under Ordinance Section 37.15 with Section 13.14 'Licensing - Notice of Rent Increase'; Rules last amended 1/13/26

https://www.sf.gov/information/sec-3715-.confirmed: full text of Sec. 37.15(a)-(e), including the license, suspension and prospective restoration

https://www.sf.gov/information/sec-373-r.confirmed: Sec. 37.3(a)(1) 60% of CPI capped at 7% and the Sec. 37.15 license condition; (a)(2) banking; (a)(3) capital improvements; (a)(5) water

https://www.sf.gov/information/sec-3710b.confirmed: Sec. 37.10B(a)(5) rent-increase-as-coercion and its bad-faith factors; (c)(5) treble damages or $1,000 statutory damages plus fees

https://www.sf.gov/information--sec-3710.confirmed: Sec. 37.10C(a)-(f): prohibition on sale and use of algorithmic devices; up to $1,000 per violation; tenant right of action

https://www.sf.gov/rent-board-fee.confirmed: $59.00 per dwelling unit 2026-2027; $29.50 recoverable; March 1 deadline; 5%/month penalty capped at 15%; fee applies to single-family homes and condos

https://www.sf.gov/notice-of-rent-board-.confirmed: 'Some rent increases given without a license will be null and void'; March 1, 2027 reporting deadline; December 14, 2026 exemption deadline

https://www.sf.gov/learn-about-san-franc.confirmed: June 13, 1979 cutoff; units with eviction protection only; wholly exempt categories

https://sf.gov/landlord-petitions-and-pa.confirmed: the six petition types; no filing fee; worksheet filings required before notice

https://sf.gov/information/topic-no-329-.confirmed: Section 6.14 unlimited increase when last original occupant vacates; the 6.14 notice and the 60-day reasonableness guideline; co-tenants excluded from the Costa-Hawkins reset

https://sf.gov/information/partial-exemp.confirmed: SFR/condo exemption for tenancies commencing on or after 1/1/1996; in-law unit makes it a two-unit building; fee and just cause still apply

https://www.sf.gov/resource--2023--rent-.confirmed: index of Ordinance, Rules and Regulations, Chapter 37A, Costa-Hawkins, Ellis Act, AB 1482

https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces.confirmed: 30 days if 10% or less; 90 days if greater than 10%, alone or combined
5% + CPI capped at 10%; no more than two increments in 12 months; (d)(3) exemption for lower local caps; (d)(5)(A)(ii) corporations excluded
vacancy decontrol framework and its exceptions

https://calcivilrights.ca.gov/housing/.confirmed: FEHA protected characteristics including source of income, immigration status, primary language, age; retaliation

https://www.sf.gov/reports--california-t.confirmed: 8.8% AB 1482 cap for San Francisco Aug 1, 2026 - Jul 31, 2027 (5% + 3.8% CPI); 'This does NOT apply for units under the rent increase limitations of the San Francisco Rent Ordinance'; corporation / REIT / LLC exclusion

https://www.sf.gov/documents/7737/537_6..confirmed: Form 537 instructions: filing a 6.14 or Costa-Hawkins petition is OPTIONAL; such increases are effective on expiration of the 30 or 90-day Civil Code 827 notice; +5 days if mailed

https://sfplanninggis.org/PIM/.confirmed: SF Property Information Map, linked by the Rent Board's 'Learn about San Francisco rental laws' page as the tool for checking when a building was built

https://github.com/kanlerxz87-cyber/Rent.confirmed: this repository's own calculation and self-test script
